The '''Council Tower''' was the building on [[Ord Cantrell/Legends|Ord Cantrell]] where the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends#The .22Council of Blood.22|Imperial Interim Ruling Council]] governed the [[Crimson Empire]] from in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]]. When [[Xandel Carivus]] disbanded the Council and declared himself [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]], he continued to rule from the tower.
